product.tagline: Tap the call. Strike does the rest.

scenes.vo: This is Tail. Tap a trading call in Telegram, and Strike places the trade.

visual.name: Tail
visual.tagline: Tap the call. Strike does the rest.

scenes.vo: Someone posts a call in a channel. You read it. You open an exchange. You type the entry, the target and the stop, and work out your size. By then, the price has moved. And the caller earns nothing.

visual.head: By the time you've typed the trade, the price has moved

rows.text: Reading a call takes a second. Placing it by hand does not.
The caller whose call moved the money earns nothing.

scenes.vo: By hand, that's six steps. With Tail, it's one tap, sized to your own risk.
Tail turns a channel call into a Strike order. The caller posts. Tail reads it. You tap. Strike holds the entry, the target and the stop.
Here's a real call. The caller pastes it, and Tail turns it into a card with Tail and Fade buttons. Nothing is posted until the caller confirms.

visual.label: 1  The caller posts a call
visual.source: Recorded live on Strike testnet, Telegram Web

scenes.vo: Tap Tail, and the bot sizes the trade from your own equity and risk. Confirm, and Strike places the order. The order number is right there.

visual.label: 2  A follower taps Tail
visual.source: Recorded live on Strike testnet, Telegram Web

scenes.vo: If a call is unclear, Tail doesn't guess. It asks one question. Long or short? One tap, and it carries on.

visual.label: 3  An unclear call becomes a question
visual.source: Recorded live on Strike testnet, Telegram Web

scenes.vo: Or take the other side. Fade flips the trade, swaps the target and the stop, and shows the new risk before you confirm.

visual.label: 4  Fade takes the other side
visual.source: Recorded live on Strike testnet, Telegram Web

scenes.vo: Messages written in plain English get an AI reading, clearly labelled. The caller still checks every price and confirms.

visual.label: 5  Plain English gets an AI reading
visual.source: Recorded live on Strike testnet, Telegram Web

scenes.vo: When the market reaches the target, the result is posted under the card. It comes from the price, not from the caller.

visual.label: 6  The result comes from the market
visual.source: Recorded live on Strike testnet, Telegram Web

scenes.vo: Callers get their record, and an estimated builder fee. Set your own builder code, and Strike pays you directly.

visual.label: 7  The caller's record and earnings
visual.source: Recorded live on Strike testnet, Telegram Web

scenes.vo: Every call also gets a public page. The home page replays a real call: the tail lands, then the result is stamped.

That's Tail. Tap the call, and Strike does the rest.
